CustomField.description: Displays whether the source change occurred during configured unusual hours and outside a deployment window.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( Unusual_Hours__c, Compliance_Reason_Code__c = "NO_DEPLOYMENT_WINDOW" ), "🌙 Odd hours • Outside deployment window", IF( Unusual_Hours__c, "🌙 Odd hours", "☀️ Standard hours" ) )
CustomField.label: Change Timing
